mission_2.prediction: The two planners that I am choosing are BFS and DFS. Using the descriptions above, I think that DFS will finish sooner than BFS on the constrained map because with the goal being so far away from the start, BFS would have to explore a large depth one depth at a time which will take a long time while DFS may get lucky and finish quicker down one deep branch since there is a lot of open space and a small amount of occupied space by the walls even for the constrained map. Also, using the Mission 1 results, DFS finished faster and with a lower expanded-nodes count than BFS on the constrained map.
mission_2.performance: For my predicted pair on the constrained map, DFS has the status "controller failed", the elapsed_s is 32.586 seconds, and the distance_m is 7.2494 m and BFS has the status "succeeded", the elapsed_s is 89.8 seconds, and the distance_m is 23.9585 m. The result supported my prediction because DFS has a lower planning_s than BFS with DFS having a planning_s of 0.0007 seconds while BFS has a planning_s of 0.0011 seconds. The elapsed_s can't be compared for BFS and DFS on the constrained map because BFS had a successful trial while DFS had a failure with an early stop. One early stop in the attempt plots that helps explain this is that at checkpoint 326 at the timestamp 35.3 seconds on the constrained map, DFS has an estimated path error of 0.07 m which may have caused the early stop for the robot even though the DFS planner on the constrained map successfully produced a planned route faster than BFS.
mission_2.choice: Using the two map charts, the delivery planner I choose is Nav2. On the open map, Nav2 has the status "succeeded" and the execution time is 35.4 seconds. On the constrained map, Nav2 has the status "succeeded" and the execution time is 74.2 seconds. One alternative to Nav2 is using BFS. On the open map, Nav2 has a distance of 10.1165 m and an average tracking error of 0.0343 m while BFS has a distance of 13.1532 m and an average tracking error of 0.0184 m. On the constrained map, Nav2 has a distance of 20.6304 m and an average tracking error of 0.0251 m while BFS has a distance of 23.9585 m and an average tracking error of 0.0256 m. The advantage that matters most for my choice of Nav2 is shorter distance and less execution time because for both the open and constrained map, Nav2 has a smaller distance_m and a smaller elapsed_s compared to BFS. On the open map, Nav2 has an execution time of 35.4 seconds compared to BFS with an execution time of 46.4 seconds and on the constrained map, Nav2 has an execution time of 74.2 seconds compared to BFS with an execution time of 89.8 seconds. On the open map, Nav2 has a distance of 10.1165 m compared to BFS with a distance of 13.1532 m and on the constrained map, Nav2 has a distance of 20.6304 m compared to BFS with a distance of 23.9585 m.
